question: Does the +0.106 structure screen survive a proper lode rebuild from dispersed/typed labels under leak-guarded spatial CV, and does it promote from screen to usable lode layer?
method: Consolidation of committed, seeded (random_state=42), deterministic outputs from four merged PRs. No model is re-run here; this reads the recorded leak-guarded-CV AUCs and paired-bootstrap CIs and states the verdict.
cv_scheme: F1 leak-guarded spatial CV: RandomForest(300, balanced, seed=42), contiguous blocks at 2x the base-model residual-variogram range, 1 km dead-zone, fold geometry fixed per dataset so each delta isolates the features; clean delta on the GeMS/regional-mapped subset (auc_gems / auc_mapped); 2000-resample paired bootstrap (2.5/97.5 percentile, P(delta>0)).

anchor_round1_broadnet.target: broad net (ARDF model 36/27/22 OR lode|vein|skarn|greisen keyword), Nome clip
anchor_round1_broadnet.base_terms: geology one-hot + akmag (~1 km statewide) + dist-to-fault + terrain
anchor_round1_broadnet.caveat: a screen on clustered positives + single RF fit, per the round-1 report

rebuild_round2_typed_district.target: typed: ARDF Cox-Singer model_code 36a (low-sulfide Au-quartz vein), dispersed within the district grid

struct_groves.note: adds NExNW fault-intersection + second-order-splay proximity (Groves et al. 2018)

dispersal_round4a_typed_disciplined.target: dispersed + disciplined typing: 36a + guarded Au-quartz recovery

verdict.summary: Survives. On the typed 36a target (same terrain+aeromag base, same auc_gems clean subset as the +0.106 anchor), the named generic features go 0.541 -> 0.679 = +0.138 (95% CI [0.0631, 0.2089], P>0 0.9995): the interval clears zero, so it is no longer just a screen. The four named features alone land at 0.679, just under the 0.7 usable gate; adding the documented NExNW intersection/splay control clears it at 0.712 (+0.17, CI [0.1081, 0.2336]). The signal also generalizes to dispersed statewide and disciplined-typed labels (round 3/4a struct_generic +0.13 to +0.33, every mapped-cell CI above zero), over a deliberately crippled regional base whose larger deltas are not comparable to the matched-base numbers.
